case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's location, well-kept green/outdoor spaces, peaceful atmosphere, friendly/attentive staff, and breakfast; some also commented on large rooms and good food. A few isolated comments noted maintenance in progress and limited daytime bar/restaurant service with slow bar service, and one reviewer suggested interior/exterior remodeling. Overall feedback mixes repeated positives with a small number of individual service or maintenance concerns.
